subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` be hidden unless `activeModel.provider` is exactly `xai`, including contexts where active-model metadata is missing?
rationale: This is both a credential-backed billing boundary and a compatibility change for users who may have intentionally used xAI tools from non-xAI model runs.

options.title: Approve fail-closed xAI gating
options.body: Keep the PR's default policy, but require factory tests, docs updates, and real current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Require explicit cross-provider opt-in
options.body: Preserve safety for default users while allowing intentional non-xAI model use through a documented opt-in path.

options.title: Keep credential-only exposure
options.body: Reject this PR direction and accept the current cross-provider billed-tool behavior as intentional.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed xAI gating
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's default policy, but require factory tests, docs updates, and real current-head proof before merge.
